about: The setup wrenches on their black rubber bench mat, modelled from scratch where the placeholder lays each: a 3/4 in combination wrench (polished chrome, 12-point box end, open end at 15 deg, 251 mm, the size stamped), a 5/16 in L hex key in black oxide swept round its bend, the Kurt vise handle (hex socket boss, bright bar, ringed black grip) laid straight as the placeholder lays it, and a T-handle lathe chuck key with a 3/8 in square drive.
reviewed: 2026-11-05: draft; layout checked against the placeholder piece by piece

wrench_stamp.about: the stamped size and alloy marks: duller than the polished chrome round them

unsure.what: the Kurt handle is a crank (a grip at right angles to its arm, as on the shop's vise model); laid flat in the placeholder's footprint its grip would stand off the mat or cross the hex key, so it is a straight bar with the grip on its end, as the placeholder has it
the stamped marks are decals 0.04 mm proud
